categories.question: You are safely indoors while the weather changes outside. What would you most like to watch from the window?

outcomes.name: Lightning far out at sea
outcomes.description: Miniature distant thundercloud with a single lightning bolt over blue ocean

outcomes.name: Big snowflakes on a pine

outcomes.name: Rain beads racing on glass
